The law firm website checklist

Everything a professional firm website needs, from domain and hosting to email, essential pages, secure forms and security. Use it to launch a new site or audit the one you have. 38 checks in 8 sections.

Print this checklistStart here

Domain and DNS

  • Domain registered in the firm's name, with auto-renew turned on
  • Registrar account protected with two-factor authentication
  • Registrar contact details current, so renewal notices arrive
  • DNS records documented (A, CNAME, MX, TXT)

Hosting and performance

  • Hosting plan includes daily, off-site backups
  • A test restore has been completed successfully
  • Free SSL certificate active, with HTTP redirected to HTTPS
  • Caching and image compression turned on
  • Uptime monitoring alerts someone at the firm

Email

  • Professional addresses on the firm's own domain
  • SPF record published, listing every service that sends mail as the firm
  • DKIM signing turned on
  • DMARC record published, starting with p=none and reviewed before enforcing
  • Two-factor authentication required on every mailbox

Essential pages

  • Home page that states who you help and how to contact you
  • A page for each practice area
  • Attorney bio pages with real photos and credentials
  • Contact page with phone, address, office hours and a map
  • Privacy policy and website disclaimer
  • Attorney advertising disclaimers where your state requires them

Contact forms and intake

  • Only essential fields collected
  • A notice that submitting the form doesn't create an attorney-client relationship
  • Spam protection (honeypot or CAPTCHA) enabled
  • Form notifications sent through authenticated SMTP
  • Every form tested end to end after changes

Security

  • Every admin account uses a unique password and 2FA
  • Unused plugins, themes and user accounts removed
  • WordPress core, themes and plugins kept updated
  • Firewall and malware scanning enabled
  • A written plan for what to do if the site is hacked

Search and visibility

  • Google Search Console verified and XML sitemap submitted
  • Unique title and meta description on every page
  • Google Business Profile claimed and consistent with the website
  • Firm name, address and phone number identical across the web

Accessibility and usability

  • Descriptive alt text on meaningful images
  • Sufficient color contrast and readable font sizes
  • Site usable with a keyboard alone
  • Tap targets and forms easy to use on a phone
